summary: Scoped starting-point critique on RAG draft
hypothesis: Scoping a 2nd-pass critique to one named failure mode — whether the user's starting point is established — should reduce rewrite risk and fix the single dominant recurring miss without the noise of a general audit.
technique: The exp011 contrastive RAG draft feeds into a single focused FM critique call that judges only starting-point coverage; if covered it returns the draft verbatim, otherwise it names the weakest slot and writes one replacement question. Swift then swaps at most that one slot, leaving the other six untouched.

stages.text: Draft 7 questions with contrastive RAG prompt
Judge starting-point coverage; name weakest slot
Swift swaps ≤1 weakest slot; rest verbatim
